rows.note: Use this before a film, show, or other noun when “animated” means made with cartoon or computer animation.

example.english: Let’s watch an animated film together tonight.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚一齊睇套動畫電影啦。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 jat1 cai4 tai2 tou3 dung6 waa6 din6 jing2 laa1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, personality, or manner that is lively and full of spirit.

example.english: My daughter was very animated when she was little.
example.traditional: 我個女細個嗰陣好活潑。
example.jyutping: ngo5 go3 neoi5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 hou2 wut6 put3

rows.note: Use this especially for an animated discussion, debate, response, or exchange that is enthusiastic and energetic.

example.english: Everyone had an animated discussion about this issue.
example.traditional: 大家就呢個問題傾得好熱烈。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 zau6 ni1 go3 man6 tai4 king1 dak1 hou2 jit6 lit6
